column1: Prepare the pie dough and chill at least 2 hours.
Roll one disc into a 12-inch circle, fit it into a 9-inch pie dish 1.5–2 inches deep, and refrigerate while making the filling.
Toss the apple slices with the sugar, flour, lemon juice, cinnamon, allspice, and nutmeg.
Optionally cook the filling in a large skillet over medium heat about 5 minutes until the apples just begin to soften, then let cool slightly.
Pack the filling tightly into the crust, piling it high.
Roll the second disc into a 12-inch circle, cut into strips, and weave a lattice over the filling.
Trim the excess, fold the overhang inward, pinch the crusts together, and crimp or flute the edge.
Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse sugar if using; optionally chill 20–30 minutes.
Bake on the middle rack 25 minutes with a sheet pan below to catch drips.
Lower the oven to 375°F (190°C), shield the edges, and bake 35–45 minutes more until golden and the filling bubbles (about 200°F / 93°C inside).
Cool on a rack for at least 3 hours before slicing.
